verdict.rationale: Vanta documents real-time webhooks for Vanta events with signature verification and retries (vanta-docs-4), so users can build event-driven automations. The rule logic and resulting actions have to live in external tooling, using the API (vanta-docs-23, vanta-docs-58) to act back on Vanta. Custom Tests turn pushed data into pass/fail evidence (vanta-docs-2), and the risk product automates reminders and workflows (vanta-docs-22), but neither is a user-configurable event-to-action rule engine. missing for 10: a native in-product rule/trigger builder (when-event-then-action), documented configurable action types, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
